spec: pages 55 (D0-R head) and 51 (window block at level 0), drafts 7 / 6
synthetic: all weights, constants (window-block constants, ra, m, g, h0, h1, S1CAP) and inputs are synthetic test inputs chosen by this generator; none comes from model data

format.files: each array is stored in one or more text files (parts, concatenated in the listed order); a file holds whitespace-separated lower-case hexadecimal words, 16 per line, in C (row-major) order of the stated shape; no 0x prefix

dtypes.e4m3: 2 hex digits: the e4m3 code byte (page 51.1)
dtypes.f16: 4 hex digits: IEEE binary16 bit pattern (NaN written as 7e00 / fe00)
dtypes.f32: 8 hex digits: IEEE binary32 bit pattern

format.layout: tensors are [Y][X][channel] with absolute token coordinates; window-indexed arrays use the window order j-major, i-minor (window (i, j) covers X = 8i - sx + lx, Y = 8j - sy + ly) and t = 8*ly + lx
format.weights: page 51.2 logical tensors: Wq, Wv [H][C][32]; Tb [H][12][16][16] (block k = k-th pair of tb_pair_order); Wo [H][32][C]; bo [C]; W1 [C][4C]; b1 [4C]; W2 [4C][C]; b2 [C]
format.f16_steps: distance on the ordered line of binary16 values; +0 and -0 are the same point; +-inf follow +-65504; NaN matches only NaN (any NaN bit pattern)

channels: block-output channel picks of 55.2 / 55.3 in the page 55 erratum's natural numbering: gate logits 0, 1, 2, 3; HID tanh(y14), tanh(y16); GATES y4, y5, y6; PREC y7, y8, y9; CANDW y10, y12
